column3: “idols” renders “elilim,” worthless things; “an image” renders “pesel,” a carved image, and “a figured stone” renders “a stone of carved figure (maskit).”
“will last … until” renders “will reach,” and “your food” renders “your bread (lechem).”
“act with hostility against” renders “walk contrary (qeri) with” (also in verses 23–24, 27–28 and 40–41), and “the plague” renders “a blow (makkah).”
“you are not turned to Me” renders “you will not let yourselves be disciplined by me.”
“your remains” renders “your corpses,” and “your idols” renders “gillulim.”
